row.evidence: Oracle's REST API for Common Features documents a SCIM Users resource 'used to create, update, delete, or view users in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications' (/hcmRestApi/scim/Users), and the Fusion price list sells HCM as a single base at $15.00 per hosted employee with no separate SCIM SKU.
row.notes: New row. Pricing from Oracle's public Fusion Cloud Service Global Price List (Sept 10, 2026), linked from oracle.com/corporate/pricing: HCM Base $15.00 per hosted employee per month, minimum 500, standard 3-year term (billing cadence not stated, so per-month list price used). SCIM is part of Fusion's common REST APIs (Users, Roles, Schemas, ResourceTypes, Bulk) with basic auth; it is not sold separately, so status is free with medium confidence (price list does not mention SCIM). Deprovisioning sets active=false (account suspended) or deletes. No SCIM Groups resource (Roles instead), so groups=false. Scored as a provisioning target per rule 3b; HCM is usually the HR source that IdPs import from (outbound recorded in fallbacks.other_sync). SAML SSO is configured in the Security Console or the Fusion OCI IAM identity domain (Oracle Apps type, included with SaaS). Entra 'native' rests on the 'Oracle Fusion ERP' gallery app, which provisions to the same Fusion SCIM endpoint.

plans.name: Fusion Human Capital Management Base Cloud Service
plans.price_text: $15.00 per Hosted Employee per month (minimum 500; standard 3-year term)
plans.notes: Metric is per hosted employee, not per named user. Options (Talent, Recruiting, Payroll, etc.) are add-ons to this base.

scim.plan: Fusion Human Capital Management Base Cloud Service

auth.token_source: Fusion user account with security administration privileges (Security Console)

endpoints.notes: No Groups resource: Fusion exposes /hcmRestApi/scim/Roles instead, with PATCH on members.

deprovision.data_retained: Setting active=false suspends the user account (it remains, can be re-activated); DELETE /Users/{id} removes the user account.

custom.how: Oracle extension urn:scim:schemas:extension:fa:2.0:faUser: userCategory, accountType, partyInformation (partyNumber, PartyUsage), workerInformation (personNumber, manager, job, businessUnit, department), assignServiceAdminRoles. Customer-defined attributes are not documented.

group: Roles: id, name, displayName, description, category, members

roles.how: roles attribute on Users, and PATCH /hcmRestApi/scim/Roles/{id} members to add or remove role membership

limitations.text: No SCIM Groups resource; role membership is managed through the Roles resource.
Authentication shown is HTTP Basic with a Fusion user name and password.

scim.notes: SCIM API is part of the REST API for Common Features shared by all Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications (HCM, ERP, SCM, CX Sales) on the same pod. Its core schema URN is written urn:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User in Oracle's example (not the RFC 7643 urn:ietf:params form). No separate SCIM or identity SKU appears on the Fusion Cloud price list.

user_api.plan: Fusion Human Capital Management Base Cloud Service

auth.notes: Basic auth as shown in the common Fusion REST examples; OAuth options were not checked.

webhooks_user_events.notes: No push webhooks; the User Requests Atom feed (/hcmRestApi/atomservlet/user/userRequests) publishes user lifecycle entries.

user_api.notes: api_tax false: the only HCM base SKU carries the REST APIs; no separate API SKU appears on the price list (inferred from the price list, not stated).

okta.notes: OIN 'Oracle Human Capital Management' (updated May 2026) ticks SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Sync Password, Schema Discovery and Entitlement Management in page markup; builder not stated. Aquera's 'Oracle HCM Cloud Connector' and 'User Mastering Connector' import users from HCM into Okta (HR-as-master, third party; c43).

entra.notes: Gallery app is named 'Oracle Fusion ERP' but targets the shared Fusion SCIM endpoint (/hcmRestApi/scim/) used by HCM on the same pod. No HCM-specific Entra tutorial (oracle-hcm-tutorial, oracle-fusion-hcm-tutorial 404). Basic auth only; no group provisioning; roles via Entra groups named after Fusion roles.

fallbacks.other_sync: Oracle HCM is usually the HR system of record: worker hires create user accounts in Fusion, and IdPs can import users from it (Okta HR-as-master connectors by Aquera). Outbound feed: User Requests Atom feed.

open_questions: Docs do not say whether suspending or deleting a user via SCIM ends active sessions or frees a subscription unit (HCM is metered per hosted employee, not per user).
SCIM rate limits and maximum page size are not documented.
Whether OAuth/JWT bearer tokens are accepted on /hcmRestApi/scim is not stated on the SCIM pages (examples use basic auth).
Builder of the Okta 'Oracle Human Capital Management' app is not stated.
